commit.subject: LU-19712 lfs: Add pin and not-pool options in setstripe
commit.message:
LU-19712 lfs: Add pin and not-pool options in setstripe

Introduce --pin and --not-pool options in lfs setstripe to pin a file
to a pool and to deny a pool for a file respectively.
